name: Beat the Beast: Quetzalcoatl's Trial
review:
A jungle-temple entry in the Beat the Beast series. The bonus game is the heart of it, with wild collection, symbol upgrades and a free spins mode that climbs through five levels.

Climbing those levels is what you're playing for, since each one makes the bonus stronger, and stalling early is common. Very high volatility, 5,555x cap, 96.16% RTP. Try the demo to see how often you get past the first level.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
